newsitem.title: GERMANY: Jagoda-jobless fall due mainly to mild weather.
newsitem.headline: Jagoda-jobless fall due mainly to mild weather.

text.p: German Federal Labour Office President Bernhard Jagoda said on Tuesday the March fall in unemployment was mainly due to milder weather, and that the economy continued to give little impulse to jobs creation.

"There were many job losses in the early part of the year above all because of bad weather....The exceptionally mild weather in March made rehiring workers in outdoor jobs easier," he said in remarks prepared for delivery at a news conference on the March unemployment data.
